name: load_id
description: Unique sortable identifier for one physical load attempt.

name: source_feed
description: Logical upstream feed being loaded, such as schedule, corpus, trust, or vstp.

name: record_family
description: Logical record family loaded by this attempt, such as publication, tiploc, association, or schedule.

name: source_object
description: GCS object path containing the exact source data used by this load attempt.

name: source_generation
description: GCS generation identifying the exact physical version of the source object.

name: publication_sequence
description: Source publication sequence where available. Nullable because a load may fail before source metadata can be read.

name: extract_type
description: Source extract type where available, for example full or update. Nullable because a load may fail before source metadata can be read.

name: status
description: Terminal status of the load attempt. Expected values are SUCCEEDED or FAILED.

name: row_count
description: Number of rows successfully committed by the load attempt. Null for failed attempts.

name: started_at
description: UTC timestamp at which the load attempt started.

name: finished_at
description: UTC timestamp at which the load attempt reached its terminal state.

name: error
description: Error detail captured for a failed load attempt. Null for successful attempts.
